verification: Report digest matches the separately printed remote stdout receipt; source digests match the pinned Git commits. Read-only EC2 observation confirmed the disposable instance terminated and the original study instance stopped with its original volume binding.
scope: Actual anonymized report from an operator-authorized disposable-instance rehearsal; not a B2 capture, study result, or capture approval.
limits: Observed within approximately one minute of boot, after cloud-init returned and apt-daily was inactive; later timer-driven units were not exercised.
Anonymization removes process identities and most argument values. The report is not a replayable full process census.
The regression replays only the three fully preserved system-daemon command lines in a synthetic identity/process envelope; numeric UID 999 and PIDs are synthetic.
historical_evidence: reboot-checks.json records the pre-execution preparation and tests at its original source revision; this fixture supplements that record.
